verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 96.1 (-0.1% in a day) and momentum is 41: prices are falling. 84s cost 950, 85s 2,500 and 86s 4,500. Champions weekend starts Friday, when demand for meta cards usually peaks.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-13T10:06:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Khadija Shaw 91 Team of the week after its 76% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 78,000 coins. Now 72,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 76.1% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 8 of 15 so far, averaging +5.1% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy 86-rated fodder after Rivals rewards, sell or use by Saturday
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 5,500 coins. Now 4,500. Rivals rewards dip: Rivals rewards flood the market with fodder on Thursday morning, and SBC demand lifts it again by the weekend. Picked because it is the cheapest 86 is 5,500 coins. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 2 of 3 so far, averaging +19.1% after tax. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Buy cards you want for Champions before Friday evening
moves.detail: Demand for meta cards usually peaks when Champions weekend starts, so buying the cards you will play earlier is usually cheaper.

moves.title: Fodder: 86s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 950 (1.14 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,500 (1.19 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,500 (1.10 coins per Item Score point), 87s 7,100 (1.29 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,750 (1.54 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 86s then 84s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Joel Ordoñez and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Joel Ordoñez 76 Rare -68.5%; Karim Adeyemi 82 Rare -46.2%; Konstantinos Karetsas 76 Rare -45.0%; Marcus Rashford 82 Rare -37.6%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.

moves.title: Loïs Openda SBC ends soon
moves.detail: It costs about 114.3K coins to complete. Compare that with what you get before you build.
